# polaris_principal_role (Data Source)

Fetches a Polaris principal role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_principal_role" "data_engineer" {
  name = "data-engineer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the principal role.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Version of the principal role object, used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `federated` (Boolean) Whether the principal role is federated, that is managed by an external identity provider.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the principal role.
